events.title: Watch the Developer Play VOIVOD: The Nuclear Warrior!
events.summary: Join Nicola, developer of VOIVOD: The Nuclear Warrior, for a special gameplay showcase during Steam Next Fest!Discover the game's exploration, intense run-and-gun combat, mutated enemies, and twisted sci-fi world.🤘 The free demo is available NOW on Steam!This broadcast features pre-recorded developer gameplay.
